records.name: Lovell Pugh-Bassett
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Institutional Effectiveness, Advancement, and Strategic Initiatives
records.notes: Became the college's sixth president on July 1, 2022; first person of color to lead the college in its 56-year history. Previously spent 20 years with the NJ Department of Education.

records.name: Donald A. Borden
records.priorInstitution: Audubon Public School District (Camden County, NJ)
records.notes: Fifth president, appointed April 2016; retired June 30, 2022 after not seeking reappointment.

records.name: Raymond Yannuzzi
records.notes: Fourth president; had served as VP Academic Affairs at CCC starting 2000.

records.name: Phyllis Della Vecchia
records.notes: Third president; led development of the Cherry Hill campus.

records.name: Aaron Milner
records.notes: Appointed president effective February 1, 2024, approved by the ACCS Board of Trustees.

records.name: Frazier Payne
records.notes: Appointed Interim/Acting President by ACCS Chancellor following Craig Pouncey's retirement in November 2023; served until Milner's start in Feb 2024.

records.name: Craig Pouncey
records.notes: Appointed president in 2019 by the ACCS Chancellor; retired in 2023. Coastal Alabama itself was formed in 2017 by merging Alabama Southern, Faulkner State, and Jefferson Davis community colleges, so Pouncey is effectively the college's second president since consolidation.

records.name: Shanna L. Jackson
records.priorTitle: Associate Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, Williamson Campus
records.notes: Appointed by the Tennessee Board of Regents; began leading Nashville State on June 1, 2018.

records.name: Kim McCormick
records.notes: Served as interim president between George Van Allen's retirement and Shanna Jackson's start.

records.name: George Van Allen
records.notes: Nashville State's fourth president; served nearly 25 years before retiring in December 2017. Start year is approximate based on ~25-year tenure.

records.name: Rebekah Woods
records.notes: Sixth president in CBC's history (started November 2017) and the college's first female president; still serving as of 2026.

records.name: Richard "Rich" Cummins
records.notes: Served roughly nine years as president; had worked at CBC since 1990 as faculty, dean, and vice president before becoming president.

records.name: Karin Edwards
records.priorTitle: Community college president/administrator (36 years of community college experience)
records.notes: Board of trustees voted unanimously in February 2020 to offer her the position; became first woman of color to lead Clark College in its 87-year history. Exact prior institution/title not independently confirmed in this pass.

records.name: Robert "Bob" K. Knight
records.notes: Served as Clark College president from August 2007 until his 2019 retirement; formerly commanded Vancouver Barracks.

records.name: Doug Berry
records.priorTitle: Provost and Vice President of Student Affairs
records.notes: Named Acting President on July 29, 2026, after Lisa Rhine's departure; joined Yavapai's leadership team in 2023, previously Dean of Liberal Arts and Sciences at Maricopa County Community College District. Board approved ~$70K for a permanent presidential search shortly after.

records.name: Lisa Rhine
records.notes: 10th president of Yavapai College, started February 2019. Departed in 2026 amid board tension, moving to become president of Central Arizona College.

records.name: Penelope "Penny" Wills
records.notes: Began tenure as Yavapai College president August 1, 2011; retired in 2018.

records.name: Bryan Renfro
records.notes: Named Chancellor in April 2025, stepped into the role in July 2025. Prior leadership roles at Colorado Mountain College, Tarrant County College District, Eastern Kentucky University, and NorthWest Arkansas Community College.

records.name: Liang Chee Wee
records.notes: Named Interim Chancellor in September 2023 following Sonya Williams' resignation.

records.name: Sonya Williams
records.notes: Resigned as Chancellor after roughly one year in the role.

records.name: Don Doucette
records.notes: Retired July 2022 when his contract ended, after serving as chancellor since 2011.

records.name: Marta Yera Cronin
records.notes: Fifth president of DCCC, began July 1, 2023; second woman and first Latina to lead the college.

records.name: L. Joy Gates Black
records.notes: College's first African American and first female president; served July 2017-June 2023 (announced retirement in 2022).

records.name: Jerome S. Parker
records.notes: Third president; served the college for 14 years until July 1, 2017 (start year approximate).

records.name: Steve Hall
records.notes: Listed as Acting President on Oxnard College's official site as of August 2026. Could not independently confirm exact appointment date or what became of Roberto Gonzalez; flagging this transition as unconfirmed/needs verification.

records.name: Roberto Gonzalez
records.notes: Selected from a 3-finalist search in March 2024; began as Oxnard College president July 1, 2024. End date estimated based on Steve Hall's current Acting President status; not independently confirmed.

records.name: Oscar Cobian
records.notes: Served as Interim President of Oxnard College ahead of the 2024 presidential search (was also a finalist).

records.name: Cynthia Azari
records.priorInstitution: Fresno City College / Riverside City College / Butler County Community College (PA)
records.notes: Appointed 2016, succeeding James Limbaugh; brought 30+ years of community college administrative experience.

records.name: Annesa Payne Cheek
records.priorInstitution: St. Cloud Technical and Community College (MN)
records.notes: Became FCC's 11th president July 1, 2022; previously president of St. Cloud Technical and Community College for four years and held roles at Sinclair Community College (OH) for 12+ years.

records.name: Thomas Powell
records.notes: Served as Interim President between Elizabeth Burmaster and Annesa Cheek.

records.name: Elizabeth Burmaster
records.notes: Served as FCC president 2014-2021.

records.name: Chato Hazelbaker
records.notes: Selected after nationwide search, began role in July 2024, succeeding retiring Patricia Erjavec. At Northland Pioneer, he had increased retention by 7% and reversed a decade-long enrollment decline.

records.name: Patricia A. Erjavec
records.notes: 13th president of PCC and the school's first female president; served June 1, 2010 through her 2024 retirement (14-year tenure).

records.name: Heidi Popham
records.notes: Appointed president effective June 16, 2019, after more than 23 years at GNTC in roles including Director/VP of Institutional Effectiveness and Executive Vice President.

records.name: Craig McDaniel
records.notes: Named president of the newly-merged Georgia Northwestern Technical College in July 2009 (formed from the consolidation of Coosa Valley Technical College and Northwestern Technical College).

records.name: Monica Torres
records.notes: 10th president/Chancellor of DACC; served as interim starting Sept 2018 (had been VP Academic Affairs since 2014), converted to permanent president/chancellor May 10, 2019. Note: in May 2024 Torres also began serving as interim president of the main NMSU university (succeeding Arvizu/Gogue) while apparently retaining her DACC chancellor title per the college's own site as of this research pass -- current day-to-day DACC leadership during this dual role is unconfirmed.

records.name: Margie Huerta
records.notes: Retired effective January 31, 2014; during her tenure DACC saw its largest enrollment increase in college history.

records.name: Staci Martin
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Student Life and College Affairs / Registrar
records.notes: Named Interim President Nov 1, 2025; named sole finalist for permanent 10th president role in April 2026, with formal board appointment expected ~May 11, 2026 after the required Texas 21-day waiting period. Had held multiple KC leadership roles since 2001.

records.name: Brenda S. Kays
records.notes: Ninth president of Kilgore College, served Feb 1, 2016 - Feb 28, 2026.

records.name: William Holda
records.notes: Served Aug 1, 1996 - Jan 31, 2016 (19.5 years), the college's longest-serving president after founder W.L. Dodson.

records.name: Marshall T. Fulbright III
records.priorTitle: Tenured faculty (Music); department chair, academic senator
records.notes: Became MPC superintendent/president July 10, 2023. Prior direct predecessor's identity and tenure dates could not be independently confirmed in this research pass; MPC's founding president was Calvin Flint (1947-1958).

records.name: Pamela Monaco
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Academic and Student Affairs
records.notes: Became OCC's first female president in July 2023, succeeding Jon Larson; brings 30+ years of higher-education experience.

records.name: Jon H. Larson
records.notes: Fourth president of OCC, served August 2000-June 2023 (longest-serving OCC president).

records.name: Eric Leshinskie
records.priorTitle: Interim Executive Vice Chancellor and Provost
records.notes: Named the fourth president of SCC in July 2022; previously VP of Academic Affairs at Paradise Valley Community College and Glendale Community College.

records.name: Chris Haines
records.notes: Third named president of SCC (preceded by Jan Gehler and founding president Art DeCabooter, who served 30 years). Exact tenure start date not confirmed in this research pass.

records.name: Carol S. Spalding
records.notes: Third president of Rowan-Cabarrus Community College, in office since 2008; named NC Community College President of the Year in 2019. Confirmed as current president via Wikipedia as of this research pass.

records.name: Richard Brownell
records.notes: Second president of the college; later named President Emeritus. Exact tenure dates not confirmed in this research pass.
